llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is an instruction-only market-data helper that uses curl to call mkts.io endpoints and optionally accepts an MKTS_API_KEY—no unrelated credentials, installs, or file access are requested.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (market data) match the SKILL.md: all required actions are HTTP calls to mkts.io and curl is the only binary required. There are no environment variables or binaries that are unrelated to fetching market data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains curl examples targeting mkts.io endpoints only. It does not instruct reading local files, accessing other services, or transmitting unrelated data. The only optional action that could send personal data is registering for an API key (POSTing an email/name), which is explicitly shown and optional.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only, which is the lowest-risk install mechanism. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables; MKTS_API_KEY is marked optional and is appropriate for rate-limiting/authorization. No unrelated secrets or platform credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and the skill does not request persistent system-wide configuration or modify other skills. It can be invoked autonomously by the agent (default) but does not request elevated privileges or persistent presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and only issues curl requests to mkts.io; still verify you trust mkts.io before using it. If you choose to register for an API key, avoid reusing sensitive or high-privilege credentials—use a dedicated email and store the key securely. Be aware the skill will send queries and (optionally) your email/name to an external service when you register; if you do not trust mkts.io, do not provide an API key or register. Finally, monitor rate limits and do not embed other secrets in the MKTS_API_KEY environment variable.
